content.markdown: Dunn County is a county in the U.S. state of North Dakota. As of the 2020 census, the population was 4,095, and was estimated to be 4,058 in 2025. The county seat is Manning and the largest city is Killdeer.

descriptions.en: county in North Dakota, United States
